title.zh: 原子氢四族碰撞矩阵组装

summary: Assemble the saved KN1DPy atomic SIG_CX, SIG_H_H, SIG_H_H2 and SIG_H_P matrices from a cylindrical normalized velocity carrier. Five theta nodes and Fortran-order flattening are retained; the four cross sections bind to maintained SciRel leaves. This is a bounded development reconstruction, not a physical collision-operator validation.

identity.relation: atomic H four-family normalized collision-kernel matrix assembly
identity.direction: normalized cylindrical velocity axes, cell weights, normalization energy and mass ratio -> four SIG matrices and predecessor geometry
identity.definition: For each pair (vr_i,vx_j), (vr_k,vx_l), five midpoint theta nodes form relative-speed squared v_v2 and signed vr2_vx2. Each family multiplies the corresponding SciRel cross section at its source energy factor by v_v, averages over theta, weights by Vr2pidVr_k*dVx_l and reshapes the result to (nvr*nvx,nvr*nvx) in Fortran order (row i+nvr*j, column k+nvr*l). SIG_CX uses 0.5*H_MASS*Vth2/Q; SIG_H_H uses 0.5*H_MASS*mu*Vth2/Q, the viscosity fit and /8; SIG_H_H2 and SIG_H_P use the CX energy factor and an additional signed vx_j-vx_l weight. Vth2=(sqrt(2*Q*Tnorm/(mu*H_MASS)))^2, with saved H_MASS and Q constants.
identity.model: saved KN1DPy four-family atomic velocity-space quadrature, with SciRel cross-section operators as exact dependencies
identity.geometry: cylindrical velocity space with radial speed vr, axial velocity vx and five-point azimuthal theta quadrature
identity.coordinates: vr and vx are dimensionless v/Vth; source and target velocity pairs flatten in Fortran order
identity.boundary: vr is positive and strictly increasing; vx is strictly increasing with both signs; radial weights are nonnegative, axial widths are positive, Tnorm and mu are positive real scalars; signed elastic cells are retained
assumptions: The saved constants H_MASS=1.6726231e-27 kg and Q=1.602177e-19 C are retained; Tnorm is the normalization energy in eV implied by the thermal-speed formula.
The H-H2 and H+-H cross-section leaves return a leading singleton axis; assembly removes that one declared wrapper axis before multiplication.
The source's Do_SIG gates, KH.Internal cache and other collision families are outside this stateless relation.

inputs.name: vr
inputs.constraints: Nonempty, finite, positive and strictly increasing.

inputs.name: vx
inputs.constraints: Nonempty, finite, strictly increasing, containing at least one negative and one positive node; exact symmetry is not required.

inputs.name: Vr2pidVr
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonnegative and aligned with vr.

inputs.name: dVx
inputs.constraints: Finite, positive and aligned with vx.

inputs.name: Tnorm
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; arrays, booleans and numeric strings are rejected.

inputs.name: mu
inputs.description: Mass in multiples of the saved hydrogen mass.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; arrays, booleans and numeric strings are rejected.

outputs.name: SIG_H_H
outputs.description: H-H elastic viscosity kernel with signed vr2_vx2 and /8.

outputs.name: SIG_H_H2
outputs.description: H-H2 elastic kernel with signed axial-difference weight.

outputs.name: SIG_H_P
outputs.description: H-H+ elastic kernel with signed axial-difference weight.
outputs.constraints: Finite; negative cells and the source's exact 10 eV cross-section zero are retained.

outputs.name: v_v2
outputs.description: Squared normalized relative speed at each theta node.
outputs.constraints: Predecessor geometry returned for parity inspection.

outputs.name: v_v
outputs.description: Normalized relative speed at each theta node.

outputs.name: vx_vx
outputs.constraints: Signed and zero values are retained.

outputs.name: Vth2
outputs.constraints: Finite and positive on accepted calls.

preconditions: The caller supplies the source velocity carrier and accepts its five-node theta and Fortran-index conventions.
The four bound SciRel cross-section fits and their declared clipping and branch behavior apply.
supported: Stateless assembly of the atomic H four-family SIG matrices on finite normalized cylindrical velocity grids.
excluded: Do_SIG gating, cache lifecycle, SIG_D2 and other families, Alpha/Omega contraction, source iteration and external physical validation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-real, non-finite, misaligned or out-of-domain carriers, including non-increasing vr/vx and non-scalar Tnorm/mu.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if thermal normalization is not representable, an assembled family is non-finite, or a bound cross-section rejects an energy; no matrix is returned on failure.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; finite five-node quadrature has no iteration.

provenance.lineage_summary: Development integration from saved KN1DPy 原子氢碰撞矩阵组装, source anchor kinetic_h.py:888-1018; saved implementation SHA-256 80fcd63681d255fbe6a2a0fc2e400d63143c9809099d1181bb30ef3266a956fe. Embedded source fits were replaced with four maintained SciRel leaves. Strictly increasing vr and scalar real normalization inputs are enforced as documented repairs. The saved bundle is in re-review and KN1DPy's strict D1 qualification is withdrawn; this is bounded historical development comparison, not qualified-L1 provenance or expert approval.

example.description: Build a two-by-two velocity carrier and inspect matrix order and the source weight axis.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.collisions import assemble_atomic_hydrogen_collision_matrices
r = assemble_atomic_hydrogen_collision_matrices(
    vr=np.array([0.5, 1.0]), vx=np.array([-1.0, 1.0]),
    Vr2pidVr=np.array([1.0, 2.0]), dVx=np.array([2.0, 2.0]), Tnorm=1.0,
)
assert r['SIG_CX'].shape == (4, 4)
assert r['v_v2'].shape == (2, 2, 2, 2, 5)
assert np.isfinite(r['SIG_H_H']).all()
assert (r['SIG_H_H'] < 0).any()
assert r['Vth2'].shape == (1,)
example.expected: Four finite 4-by-4 SIG matrices, retained signed elastic cells, five-node predecessor geometry and a one-element thermal-speed-square result.

scope: All four matrices agree with an independent broadcast-geometry and fit oracle to relative tolerance 1e-12 on canonical and holdout grids.
Fortran flattening, theta geometry, signed elastic cells and nonnegative CX are retained.
Input repairs are covered by failing-before-fix regressions; SHA-pinned historical replay compares finite cases to relative tolerance 1e-12.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct tests establish source-formula agreement, shapes, signs and failure semantics on tested carriers. Optional SHA-gated replay establishes bounded agreement with the saved implementation on two grids, not a qualified source freeze or external atomic-physics oracle.
known_limitations: The source bundle's strict D1 qualification is withdrawn; historical replay cannot be upgraded to qualified-L1 provenance without new source review.
Negative elastic cells and the H+-H exact 10 eV cross-section zero are preserved; physical interpretation is unresolved.
Public distribution licensing and expert approval remain pending.
